recipes.name: Manhattan
recipes.method: Stir the whiskey, vermouth and bitters with ice until very cold. Strain into a chilled coupe and drop in the cherry.

recipes.name: Whiskey sour
recipes.method: Shake everything without ice first if you use egg white, then again with ice. Strain over fresh ice in a short glass. A few drops of bitters on the foam.

recipes.name: Dry martini
recipes.method: Stir the gin and vermouth with plenty of ice for thirty seconds. Strain into a frozen martini glass. Twist the lemon peel over it, or add the olive.

recipes.name: Aviation
recipes.method: Shake everything hard with ice and double strain into a chilled coupe. It should be the pale sky blue the name promises.

recipes.name: Cosmopolitan
recipes.method: Shake everything with ice and strain into a chilled martini glass. Flame an orange peel over the top.
